claims.statement: Cupid's June 2026 quarter shows strong year-on-year growth in reported revenue and net profit, corroborated by the current consolidated financial snapshot and the company's FY27 Q1 reporting archive.

The current consolidated snapshot shows a very high earnings multiple and market valuation relative to book value; this is treated as a negative valuation input, not as a standalone short signal or price target.
June 2026 shareholding data show higher FII, DII and promoter ownership than March 2026, providing positive historical ownership confirmation while not asserting current-session institutional flow.

Cupid issued a Q2 FY27 business update on September 30, and independent coverage on October 1 reported another increase in FY27 revenue and net-profit guidance together with expected Q2 revenue above the prior run-rate. This is a current positive business catalyst, while actual Q2 audited results remain pending.

Review of the company's recent FY27 disclosures and current independent coverage did not identify a verified company-specific severe shock such as default, fraud, insolvency, ban, auditor resignation or comparable acute adverse event. Recent SAST disclosures, trading-window closure and warrant-related notices are not relabelled as severe Event-Shock evidence.

limitations: Freshness refers to this research session; underlying financial periods and corporate events retain their own event dates.
No live Upstox price, ATR, liquidity or sector-regime value is supplied by this research artifact; production must acquire those independently.
The guidance update is management guidance and business-update evidence, not audited Q2 results.
Historical shareholding changes do not establish current-session institutional buying.
No price target or production recommendation is created by this storage-only research artifact.
